description: Execute an npm package executable (CLI), automatically installing into a global shared cache if not installed in node_modules.

option.name: --bun
tip: Force the command to run with Bun instead of Node.js.
Must be placed before the package name.

option.name: --no-install
tip: Skip installation if the package is not already installed.

option.name: --package
tip: Specify a package to install when the binary name differs from the package name.
